sentences.text: The contention of the learned counsel for the appellant is that no offence against the appellant is disclosed and the present prosecution has been instituted with a mala fide intention for the purpose of harassment.

Per contra, the learned A.G.A.-I for the State as well as learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 have contended that from the allegation made in the F.I.R. prima facie offence is made out against the appellant.
The innocence of the appellant cannot be adjudged at the pre trial stage.

Therefore,
the appellant does not deserve any indulgence.

After arguing at some length learned counsel for the appellant has made a request that appellant may be permitted to file his regular bail before the appropriate court of law and a direction may be issued to dispose of such application at the earliest in the light of dictum of Apex Court in Criminal Appeal No.929 of 2021, Aman Preet Singh vs. C.B.I. through Director.
Thus, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the present appeal moved on behalf of the appellant is finally disposed of in terms that the appellant may move an appropriate regular bail application before the trial court and if such an application is moved, the trial court shall be under an obligation to dispose of the same strictly, in accordance with the law as laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court inCriminal Appeal No.929 of 2021, Aman Preet Singh vs. C.B.I. through Director after hearing the Public Prosecutor.
Order Date :- 18.9.2023 Piyush/-
